method: Index complete quoted strings, identifier-like tokens, standalone zero-prefixed numbers and ISO dates from outputs; stream all 1M known rows and match by hash-set equality. Count occurrences once per matched value, even if present in multiple source rows/columns.
matching: case-sensitive UTF-8 text; JSON string unescaping; SQL doubled-quote unescaping; gzip decompressed in memory/stream; no raw docker log persisted
scope: All regular files beneath repo results/, including runner logs and decompressed gzip.
Existing private benchmark *.log files only; no token/key/account files opened.
pytest temporary files whose paths identify benchmark/paired/API tests.
Entire currently retained docker logs pg-dpr, both streams.
limitations: This is a bounded operational plaintext scan, not a secret scanner or exhaustive substring search.
Values shorter than 6 characters and plaintext REF categories excluded to avoid category/metric collisions.
Unquoted multiword values, arbitrary substrings, non-UTF8, UTF16, binary/custom dumps, other encodings, encrypted/deleted/rotated logs and external exports may be missed.
Matching dates alone can be coincidental public timestamps or methodology metadata; counts do not prove a personal-data leak.
No whole-Windows-temp or unrelated user file scan; only benchmark-related pytest temp paths.
sql/baseline/02_data.sql intentionally excluded by CONTRACT section 11 and verify/scan_config.toml; outside this log/results scan scope.
notes: No data values, snippets or per-value hashes included. No database or OpenBao writes; S02 SQL attempts may add statement text to existing server error logs.
